title: C(n+1) inhomogeneous deformation triviality audit
scope: Data stated in the repository definitions only; no external sources used.

conclusion.reason: No explicit map from gb parameters to adjoint-valued 2-cochains and no complete structure-constant table in a fixed homogeneous basis are supplied.

cochain_coordinate_convention.parity: odd cochains: output parity is input parity sum plus 1 modulo 2
coordinate_blocks: even-even input pairs: binom(m,2), output in g_odd
odd-odd input pairs: binom(q+1,2), output in g_odd
mixed input pairs: m*q, output in g_even

triviality_system.D_n: matrix of the supplied coboundary formula on odd endomorphisms f
triviality_system.G_n: matrix of the missing parameter-to-cocycle map
triviality_system.equivalent_parameter_conditions: L_n*G_n*gb = 0, where rows of L_n span the left nullspace of D_n
triviality_system.overall_fixed_nonzero_scalar: Does not change the test; absorb it into f by linearity.
triviality_system.pair_dependent_scalar: Not a defined cochain equality and is not used.

unavailable_required_data.normalization_resolution_for_E_2delta_n: Simple-root display uses 1/2*(b_n^+)^2; all-root display uses (b_k^+)^2.
unavailable_required_data.effect: D_n and G_n cannot be instantiated from the supplied files; no individual gb triviality conditions or nonzero examples can be verified.
